mapper.sql: id, user_id, login_ip, login_device, login_location, login_time, login_status, fail_reason
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_login_log (user_id, login_ip, login_device, login_location, login_status, fail_reason) VALUES (#{userId}, #{loginIp}, #{loginDevice}, #{loginLocation}, #{loginStatus}, #{failReason})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(login_time) FROM sys_login_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND login_status = 1
